accounting_reserves.rule: These reserves are inside the unchanged global totals. Linux stage allocations sum to 550 CPU-seconds and 751 wall-seconds. The Linux child process tree is counted once: the WSL launcher RUSAGE_CHILDREN measurement is authoritative and the supervisor self-plus-child value is only a consistency check. The single CPU second outside stage allocations is reserved for measured Windows post-preflight work; the two wall seconds cover cross-system return and settlement. No stage can borrow another stage's allocation.

approval_basis: One bounded production-collector label-qualification run only. It cannot establish model accuracy, action-ranking benefit, or task benefit; any later model experiment requires a separate frozen protocol and authorization.

derivation.active_storage_bytes: 2*193032425-byte verified export rounded up to 512 MiB
derivation.aggregate_native_plus_verified_export_by: twice the rounded active-storage allowance, 1 GiB
derivation.all_resident_rss_bytes: 2*771072000 measured peak bytes from the prior attempt, rounded up to 2 GiB
derivation.complete_process_cpu_seconds: ceil(3*163.57187984099997 measured seconds from the completed history-repair attempt) = 491 collection; add 20 staging/zero-step + 39 settlement/export + 1 Windows post-preflight CPU reserve = 551. The former 1-second native-launcher reserve is reallocated to settlement accounting because native supervisor and worker CPU are measured once as the complete Linux child process tree.
derivation.environment_steps: 8*4 prefix steps + 200*(1 forced first action + 13 horizon-limited continuation steps), derived from 18-second horizon, 1-second decision interval, and first decision at or after t=4s
derivation.public_rule_decisions: 8*4 public NOOP prefix decisions + 200*13 Hungarian continuation decisions; forced candidate first actions are counted separately
derivation.wall_seconds: ceil(3*230.81851591199938 measured seconds from the completed history-repair attempt) = 693 collection; add 20 staging/zero-step + 38 settlement/export + 2 cross-system wall reserve = 753

matrix.candidate_set: all legal public candidates, including NOOP with task-head masks false
matrix.no_opportunity: retain parent and reason as missing; no replacement, zero imputation, or retry
matrix.parent_identity: fixed train-0056 through train-0063 with scenario and structural hashes in parent-split.json; verify against frozen source tape and historical split before authorization; any mismatch stops without substitution

qualification_rule: coverage passes only if all eight frozen parents have exactly one complete valid window containing at least one valid physical_on_time_completion or task_expired label; no-opportunity and unresolved windows remain missing; host_confirmation does not determine this gate
stops: source tape, source manifest, production module, environment config, parent, candidate, task, command, or continuation identity mismatch before or during collection
missing lifecycle or notice evidence remains unknown and is never imputed
any parent with no opportunity remains missing; no replacement or retry is allowed
any NaN, Inf, ledger, filesystem, storage, time, or export contract failure stops and seals
